q: How do I count emissions for a storage system built from second-life EV batteries?
title: Second-life EV battery storage
short: Reusing EV batteries avoids making new cells, the biggest part of a battery's footprint. Decide how to split the original manufacturing emissions between first and second life, state the rule, and add testing, repacking and transport. The storage itself only shifts electricity use.
audience: Energy storage integrators and commercial users

ul: All manufacturing emissions to the first life, so second life carries only repurposing.
A split by remaining capacity or years of service.
Testing, sorting and new battery management electronics.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
